papers.title: Tree diversity and mycorrhizal type independently shape multitrophic biodiversity, with stronger effects belowground than aboveground
papers.abstract: Tree diversity and mycorrhizal dominance are considered major drivers of multitrophic diversity and ecosystem functioning in forests. Here the authors disentangle the effects of these factors on above- and belowground trophic levels in a tree diversity–mycorrhiza diversity experiment.
papers.titleZh: 樹木多樣性與菌根類型獨立形塑多營養層生物多樣性，地下影響大於地上
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討了樹木多樣性與菌根優勢度如何作為森林中多營養層生物多樣性與生態系功能的主要驅動因子。研究人員在一項樹木多樣性與菌根多樣性實驗中，成功釐清了這些因素對地上及地下營養層各自的獨立影響。結果顯示，樹木多樣性與菌根類型能獨立形塑多營養層生物多樣性，且其產生的效應在地下大於地上。這項發現對於理解森林生態系統中生物多樣性的維持機制具有重要意義。

papers.title: Macropinocytosis-mediated recyclable LYTACs (McR-TACs) for receptor-independent protein degradation
papers.abstract: Recyclable LYTACs induce macropinocytosis to degrade proteins.

papers.summaryZh: 本研究報導了可回收 LYTACs (McR-TACs)，其能誘導巨胞飲作用（macropinocytosis）來降解蛋白質。這項技術實現了受體非依賴性的蛋白質降解方法。

papers.abstract: Symbiotic relationships of microorganisms are predicted and cataloged with a machine learning tool.

papers.summaryZh: 本研究利用機器學習工具，預測並編製了微生物共生關係的目錄，並建構出地球上細菌與古菌共生體的基因體目錄。這項成果有助於深入了解微生物共生關係的預測與分類。

papers.title: Spatial mapping of RNA turnover kinetics in the mouse brain
papers.abstract: The authors developed spatial NT-seq to map the landscape of RNA turnover and stability regulation in the mouse brain, identifying the dentate gyrus as a turnover hotspot and revealing region-specific responses to electroconvulsive stimulation.
papers.titleZh: 小鼠大腦中 RNA 轉換動力學的空間定點測繪
papers.summaryZh: 本研究開發了 spatial NT-seq，用於繪製小鼠大腦中 RNA 轉換與穩定性調控的空間景觀。研究團隊識別出齒狀迴（dentate gyrus）為 RNA 轉換熱點，並揭示了大腦區域對電痙攣刺激的特異性反應。這項技術有助於深入理解大腦中 RNA 穩態的空間調控機制。

papers.title: Good neighbors make lasting memory
papers.abstract: A population of inflammatory monocytes differentiates into persistent lung-resident Gal-1+ myeloid cells that colocalize with and support the long-term maintenance and recall responses of influenza virus-induced tissue-resident memory CD8+ T cells.
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出，發炎性單核球（inflammatory monocytes）會分化為持久的肺駐留 Gal-1+ 骨髓細胞。這些細胞與流感病毒誘導的組織駐留記憶 CD8+ T 細胞共定位，並支持其長期維持與再次免疫反應。此發現揭示了細胞間的空間與功能關聯，對於理解免疫記憶的維持具有重要意義。

papers.title: Monocyte-derived galectin-1hi cells provide innate immune help in the generation of functional memory CD8+ T cells
papers.abstract: Kim and colleagues describe a population of monocyte-derived lung galectin-1+ myeloid cells that support the generation and maintenance of lung-resident memory CD8+ T cells following influenza virus infection.
papers.titleZh: 單核球來源的 galectin-1 高表達細胞在產生功能性記憶性 CD8+ T 細胞過程中提供先天免疫協助
papers.summaryZh: Kim 及其同事描述了一群單核球來源的肺部 galectin-1+ 骨髓細胞，這些細胞在流感病毒感染後支援肺駐留記憶性 CD8+ T 細胞的產生與維持。這項研究揭示了先天免疫細胞在記憶性 T 細胞發育中的重要角色。

papers.title: Immune-mediated rheumatoid arthritis: from single-cell genomics to new therapies
papers.abstract: Ivashkiv discusses recent advances in rheumatoid arthritis research using state-of-the-art single-cell and spatial transcriptomics and organoid systems, and discusses how these insights can be leveraged to further delineate disease biology and therapeutic opportunities.
papers.titleZh: 免疫介導的類風濕性關節炎：從單細胞基因體學到新療法
papers.summaryZh: 這篇論文討論了利用先進的單細胞與空間轉錄體學以及類器官系統在類風濕性關節炎研究中的最新進展。文中探討了如何利用這些洞察來進一步闡明疾病生物學並拓展治療機會。這有助於深化對該疾病機制的理解。

papers.title: Survival of the driest
papers.abstract: The journey of Mycobacterium tuberculosis between hosts in aerosol droplets has often been viewed as a passive phase in its life cycle. Recent evidence shows that the inevitable desiccation associated with aerosol transmission triggers a program that imperfectly repairs DNA damage, generating genetic diversity and increased recovery of antibiotic-resistant mutants.

papers.title: Small serine recombinases are markers for antiphage defense system discovery
papers.abstract: Renewed interest in phage therapy has highlighted a need to understand how bacteria subvert phage infection through antiphage defense systems. Traditionally, strategies to identify antiphage defense systems lack throughput or have limitations for bacterial species where antiphage defense systems are understudied. Herein, we developed a bioinformatic pipeline that uses a small serine recombinase to identify known and unknown antiphage defense systems. Using this approach to query reference genomes and metagenomes, we show that small serine recombinase genes are genetically linked to antiphage defense systems and serve as bait for finding these systems across diverse bacterial phyla. Using co-transcription predictions and statistical analysis of protein domain abundances, we experimentally validated our bioinformatic approach by discovering that KAP P-loop NTPases are fused to putative antiphage domains and reinforce prokaryotic Schlafen proteins as a new class of antiphage defense. Our work shows that small serine recombinases are a reliable genetic marker for the discovery of antiphage defenses across diverse bacterial phyla.
papers.titleZh: 小型絲胺酸重組酶是發現抗噬菌體防禦系統的標記物
papers.summaryZh: 本研究開發了一種生物資訊管線，利用小型絲胺酸重組酶來識別已知與未知的抗噬菌體防禦系統。研究顯示，小型絲胺酸重組酶基因與抗噬菌體防禦系統在基因上具有連結性，可作為在多樣化細菌門類中尋找這些系統的誘餌。透過共轉錄預測與蛋白質結構域豐度的統計分析，研究團隊實驗驗證了此生物資訊方法，發現 KAP P-loop NTPases 與假定的抗噬菌體結構域融合，並證實原核生物 Schlafen 蛋白質為一類新的抗噬菌體防禦。這項工作表明，小型絲胺酸重組酶是跨多樣化細菌門類發現抗噬菌體防禦機制的可靠基因標記。

papers.title: Visual motion does not bias gravity-referenced vestibular coding in the primate cerebellar nodulus and uvula
papers.abstract: Visual motion is known to influence perceptions of tilt, verticality, and translation, suggesting that optic flow is combined with vestibular cues to estimate orientation relative to gravity. The cerebellar nodulus and ventral uvula (NU) are a prime candidate to perform this computation because this region uniquely receives convergent semicircular canal, otolith, and proprioceptive inputs, and in non-primate species full-field visual motion robustly modulates NU activity. Here, we tested whether visual roll motion, known to bias perceived orientation relative to gravity, alters the internal gravity-referenced transformation used by NU neurons to encode vestibular self-motion. To test this, we recorded single-unit activity from NU Purkinje cells in rhesus macaques during whole-body translations in darkness, either without visual stimulation or after prolonged full-field optokinetic roll motion. We hypothesized that visual motion simulating head tilt would bias the NU’s internal gravity estimate, leading to altered translation-evoked responses. Contrary to this prediction, visual motion had no effect on either baseline firing rates or vestibular responses. Moreover, a computational model predicting visually induced shifts in neural tuning was not supported by the data. These results show that visual roll motion, although known to influence perceived orientation, does not bias gravity-referenced vestibular coding in the primate NU. This specialization may preserve a fast, body-anchored gravity estimate for postural and reflexive motor control, delegating visual–vestibular integration for perception to downstream circuits.
papers.titleZh: 靈長類小腦 nodulus 與 uvula 的重力參考前庭編碼不受視覺運動偏誤影響
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討視覺滾轉運動是否會改變小腦 nodulus 與 ventral uvula（NU）中用以編碼前庭自我運動的內部重力參考轉換。研究團隊在恆河猴進行全身平移時記錄了 NU Purkinje 細胞的單一神經元活性，結果顯示視覺運動並不會影響其基礎放電率或前庭反應。這項發現表明，視覺滾轉運動雖然已知會影響方向感知，但並不會偏誤靈長類 NU 中的重力參考前庭編碼。這種特化有助於維持穩固且快速的身體錨定重力估計，以利姿勢與反射性運動控制，並將用於感知的視覺與前庭整合交由下游迴路處理。

papers.title: Two evolutionary histories in one nucleus: genome remodeling and allelic regulation underlying heterosis in hybrid oil palm
papers.abstract: Oil palm (Elaeis) is the primary source of global vegetable oil. Interspecific hybrids of Elaeis exhibit pronounced heterosis by integrating two distinct subgenomes into a single nucleus, effectively combining the high yield of African oil palm (E. guineensis) with the high unsaturated fatty acid content and disease resistance of American oil palm (E. oleifera). However, the genetic basis underlying heterosis is still unclear. Here, we combine phased genome assembly, comparative genomics, evolutionary genomics and haplotype-aware transcriptomics to unravel the genetic architecture of heterosis of hybrid oil palm. We assemble the highly heterozygous F1 genome ('Reyou 40', 3.75% heterozygosity) into a complete 1.73 Gb T2T haplotype (HapG) and a 1.84 Gb near-T2T haplotype (HapO with17 gaps). Despite 91.56% sequence identity, HapG and HapO diverged in LTR-RT occurrence and PAV affected genes, showing complementary biases in lipid metabolism and stress responses, respectively. Evolutionary genomics revealed that ancient WGDs preserved the palm family. Whereas lineage-specific lipid-related gene expansions in oil palm. Six ancient introgressed regions (~64 Mb) in HapG were reshaped by transposable elements and tandem duplication, showing an enrichment of genes related to resistance and lipid metabolism. Transcriptomically, 82.2% of allelic gene pairs maintained balanced expression, accompanied by parental functional complementarity and dosage buffering, revealing a potential regulatory basis for coordinating parental genetic differences in the hybrid genome. These haplotype-resolved genomic resources offer vital targets for understanding heterosis and accelerating oil palm molecular breeding.
papers.titleZh: 同核中的兩種演化史：油棕雜交種雜種優勢背後的基因組重塑與等位基因調控
papers.summaryZh: 本研究結合了分相基因組組裝、比較基因組學、演化基因組學與單倍型感知轉錄體學，探討雜交油棕雜種優勢的遺傳架構。研究團隊組裝了高度雜合的 F1 基因組，並揭示了兩套亞基因組在脂質代謝與壓力應對上展現出互補偏好。同時，大多數的等位基因對維持了平衡表達，並伴隨親本功能互補與劑量緩衝現象。這些 haplotype 解析的基因組資源為理解雜種優勢及加速油棕分子育種提供了重要的標的。
